text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Oh, pardon me. I just remembered something amusing that happened while we were all at the Mejiro vacation house during our time off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: We had great fun taking walks and chatting, but this was something that happened one night while we gathered around the card table.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Everyone was just so focused on the game, their expressions were adorable…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm ready to put my nose to the grindstone and take on the next race at full strength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Mejiro Ardan's time off was well spent!
